blocks.text: You can take remediation actions on the Active Directory (AD) user identities in which changes are detected. Remediation is available only for users with bad changes in the AD domain. You can take the following remediation actions and apply them to single or multiple users:
To run remediations for users with bad changes:

blocks.item: Go to ITDR > Active Directory Change Detection > Default or Custom.
Select an AD domain from the Result for drop-down menu.
Click the Remediation icon for the AD change you want to remediate, and then select an appropriate remediation action.
Select multiple AD user changes, click Remediations, and then select a remediation action.
Revoke Group Membership is not available for bulk remediation action.
In the confirmation window, click OK.

blocks.text: You can view the remediation logs or history for further analysis.
